title: Web Search domain & date filtering in Bedrock AgentCore
hook: What new filtering capabilities does Web Search in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore now support?

back.lead: Web Search in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore now supports domain filtering and published-date filtering, giving agents per-request control over which web sources and time windows they search.
back.hookline: Agents can now filter web searches by domain and publication date at runtime.

kv.v: Runtime control over which web sources agents search
